properties.title: Tadpole Project
properties.body_md: A first step in cleaning up the Big Coal River, starting with trash pickup along the banks of the river and its tributaries. We feel that starting the restoration of our waters with picking up the trash is a huge step in fostering the relationship of a watershed team in this area.
properties.image_desc: Blake and Jacob after a hard morning\'s work cleaning up home base of Tadpole Project.
